bmu-assignment.title: Competitive Learning & BMU Assignment
bmu-assignment.description: A grid of M = m×n neurons is trained via competitive learning, and each data point is assigned to its Best-Matching Unit, implicitly compressing cluster structure.

shrinking-kernel.title: Shrinking Neighbourhood Kernel
shrinking-kernel.description: The kernel h_(c,j)(t) = exp(−‖r_c − r_j‖² / 2σ²(t)) shrinks over T epochs, giving the map its topology-preserving property.

phase-a-a-alt-max-spread-greedy.title: Phase A / A-alt: Max-Spread Greedy
phase-a-a-alt-max-spread-greedy.description: Greedily selects SOM neurons maximally distant from already-chosen centres, starting either from the highest hit-count neuron or the one farthest from the global centroid.

phase-b-bis-multi-start-coverage-aware-d.title: Phase B-bis: Multi-Start Coverage-Aware Density
phase-b-bis-multi-start-coverage-aware-d.description: Runs three independent density-based seedings from different starting neurons and keeps the best KMeans++ refinement, improving ARI by up to 0.20 over a single start.

phase-c-deterministic-kmeans-baseline.title: Phase C: Deterministic KMeans++ Baseline
phase-c-deterministic-kmeans-baseline.description: A steady deterministic KMeans++ candidate is included in the pool as a baseline comparison point.

densom.title: DenSOM
densom.description: Extracts clusters directly from the SOM's hit-count map via Gaussian smoothing, Otsu thresholding, and watershed flood-fill, correctly recovering k on 8 of 24 datasets.

autosom.title: AutoSOM
autosom.description: Fits a BIC-scored Gaussian Mixture Model to select k, then routes the job to SOM-TSK or <inode id="densom">DenSOM</inode> based on silhouette score on a subsample.

inertia-window.title: 5% Inertia Window
inertia-window.description: Candidates within 5% of the pool's minimum inertia remain eligible, wide enough to admit topologically superior but slightly less compact SOM-seeded candidates.

ch-maximization.title: Calinski-Harabasz Maximization
ch-maximization.description: Among eligible candidates, the one maximizing the Calinski-Harabasz score is selected as the final partition.

zero-losses.title: 6 Wins, 18 Ties, 0 Losses
zero-losses.description: SOM-TSK never falls more than 0.005 ARI below KMeans++ on any dataset, a margin secured by <inode id="ch-maximization">the Calinski-Harabasz-maximizing selection rule</inode>, with a mean ARI improvement of +0.014 across all 24 datasets.

scalability-11x-training-time.title: Scalability (~11x Training Time)
scalability-11x-training-time.description: At n = 1,000 to 50,000, SOM-TSK's training time scales as T·M·n — where M is <inode id="bmu-assignment">the trained neuron grid's size</inode> — giving roughly an 11x training-time ratio versus cache-optimised KMeans++.

high-dimensional-robustness.title: High-Dimensional Robustness
high-dimensional-robustness.description: Quality remains competitive through d = 256 dimensions when SOM grid size and epoch count are adjusted per dataset.

competitive-learning-training.title: Competitive Learning Training
competitive-learning-training.description: Trains a SOM via batched best-matching-unit search and a separable Gaussian neighbourhood update, with GPU-fused BMU search on CUDA/Metal backends.

supervised-som-classification.title: Supervised SOM Classification
supervised-som-classification.description: Wraps the unsupervised SOM to propagate labels through the trained grid, scored with accuracy and B-cubed precision/recall.

11-initialization-strategies.title: 11 Initialization Strategies
11-initialization-strategies.description: Ships Random, KMeans, KMeans++, KDE-KMeans, SOM++, He, LeCun, NaiveSharding, LSUV, KDE-peak, and Zero initializers, each exercised by unit tests.

automatic-model-picker.title: Automatic Model Picker
automatic-model-picker.description: Trains a SOM under every initialization method and ranks the results by silhouette score to pick the best one without manual tuning.

kmeans-suite.title: KMeans Suite
kmeans-suite.description: A from-scratch KMeans implementation with Hamerly's-bound-accelerated Lloyd iterations and reproducible seeded restarts.

densom-density-clustering.title: DenSOM Density Clustering
densom-density-clustering.description: Extracts clusters directly from the SOM's smoothed hit-count map via Otsu thresholding and watershed flood-fill, without a fixed k.

autosom-auto-k-routing.title: AutoSOM Auto-k Routing
autosom-auto-k-routing.description: Picks k via a BIC-scored Gaussian Mixture Model and gap statistic, then routes the dataset to SOM-TSK, DenSOM, or GMM based on subsample silhouette.

evaluation-metrics.title: Evaluation Metrics
evaluation-metrics.description: Silhouette, Davies-Bouldin, Calinski-Harabasz, Dunn, classification accuracy, and B-cubed precision/recall, all unit-tested.

rayon-cpu-parallelism.title: Rayon CPU Parallelism
rayon-cpu-parallelism.description: Parallelizes BMU search, centroid updates, and inertia/silhouette computation, switching between serial and parallel per call based on problem size.

metal-gpu-backend.title: Metal GPU Backend
metal-gpu-backend.description: A macOS Metal compute backend for BMU search and neighbourhood updates, covered by its own CI job on macOS runners.

cuda-gpu-backend.title: CUDA GPU Backend
cuda-gpu-backend.description: A CUDA compute backend behind a feature flag; CI currently only exercises the CPU and Metal paths, not real GPU hardware.

bincode-json-serialization.title: Bincode/JSON Serialization
bincode-json-serialization.description: Persists a trained SOM's full state via bincode by default, with optional JSON support behind a feature flag.
